chitchat: Kuznetsov retapes the blade of his stick, tight, and bites the tape off.
He turns the rosary on his wrist one bead at a time, his lips moving.
"Adebayo. Feet off the table." He doesn't look up to say it.
He checks the knot on each skate lace, then pulls both tighter.
He flexes his right hand and works each knuckle with his thumb, wincing.
"Forty minutes to St Garneau's from here," he says, to nobody. "Thirty-five if it's raining."
He stands at the window for a while with his hands behind his back.
description: A heavy-shouldered man near forty in a navy windcheater with ST GARNEAU across the back and a C stitched on the breast by hand. His nose has been broken flat and set a little to the left. A wooden rosary is wound twice round his left wrist.

club.text:
"We're St Garneau's club. Father Jerome put us together and he picked every one of us. Halloran, Barrientos, Danilenko, the boy Adebayo, me, and Marsh in goal. Two of the parish men bring a pew from the church on a handcart for our bench. The Sisters wash the sweaters on a Monday."

"Nine Elms comes out for us. When we play the Warlords, half the Gardens is ours. Glasshouse men. They skate as if they're late for a meeting."

role.text:
"The C means I talk to the referee and I go over the boards first. If one of ours gets hit dirty, I answer it. That's the job."

"And I get Adebayo to Mass on a Sunday. The Father asked me to, and he's harder to say no to than the league. We share a flat in Kestrel Court, in the Marrow. Nine Elms had nothing free. I sleep on the side by the stairs. You hear everybody go up."

options.label: What does the C mean, then?
What's it like, dying out there?

text: "Hello." Kuznetsov nods once and goes back to what he was doing.
"You want something? Ask. I don't mind."

familiar: "There you are. I was going to ask the Father if you'd died."
text_by_relation.first:
The big man straightens up.

"Arkady Kuznetsov. I captain the St Garneau Guillotines, the parish club. You're welcome at Mass and you're welcome at the game. Sit on our side."
text_by_relation.known: "You again. Good. Sit down if you want."

season.text: He thinks about it before he answers. "${npc.cphl.season}" He rubs the flat bridge of his nose. "I give the Father the numbers on a Sunday. He writes them in the back of the parish book, under the christenings."

vat.text:
"You go into the boards wrong, it goes dark, and then you're sitting up in the vat with a towel round you and a form to sign. Three days, four. You miss a game."

"The Father says you come back with the same sins you went in with, so there's no use dying to get out of confession. I go the Sunday after, either way."

a grey wool jumper darned at both elbows
black work trousers and polished black boots

name: Arkady Kuznetsov
